page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.48xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated server instance designed for intensive parallel compute and deep learning workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM, the platform integrates 192 dedicated Intel Xeon 8469C vCPUs operating at a nominal clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The host environment provides 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 5.33 GB of RAM per virtual core.

The primary computing engine consists of 8 onboard GPUs providing an aggregate of 768 GB of dedicated video RAM, yielding 96 GB of VRAM per accelerator. Networking capabilities are anchored by a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, enabling rapid data exchange across multi-node clusters and high-volume training synchronization. The instance provision does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network block storage or remote object storage for operational file systems and persistent datasets.

From an infrastructure and resource efficiency perspective, the instance aggregates massive compute and memory density within a single node. While this consolidated architecture reduces multi-node networking overhead and inter-host latency, relying entirely on network-attached storage requires deliberate architecture to prevent I/O bottlenecks during high-throughput data loading. The platform is well suited for large language model pre-training, fine-tuning, complex multi-GPU distributed deep learning tasks, and large-scale parallel simulations.
